purpose: Predeclare family representatives, target ownership, redundancy controls and incremental-information tests before later forward market-state evidence is inspected. Preserve regime-research-v1 indicator and target definitions and discovery-v1 trading logic unchanged.

trend_structure.rationale: Directly measures trend efficiency without using strategy PnL and is conceptually distinct from absolute volatility.

volatility_regime.rationale: Causal normalized volatility-state representative with broad availability.

liquidity_microstructure.rationale: Direct executable-friction state variable and stable reference for depth or book-pressure increments.

aggressive_flow.rationale: Scale-normalized aggressive-flow representative already available from public MEXC prints.

mean_reversion.rationale: Direct normalized displacement measure aligned with the original ENA hypothesis while remaining state-first.

cross_asset_context.rationale: Measures BTC coupling without selecting on strategy PnL.

derivatives_positioning.rationale: Use only when legitimately observed; unavailable observations remain missing rather than imputed.

time_session.rationale: Predeclared stability slice, not a performance-selection variable.

predeclared_incremental_tests.interaction_rationale: ADX may add trend-strength information beyond directional efficiency.
Bandwidth may distinguish compression geometry beyond ATR percentile.
Depth may distinguish fragile from stable quotes at similar spread.
Acceleration may identify persistence or exhaustion beyond static flow imbalance.
RSI is allowed only if it adds information beyond the predeclared displacement representative.
Flow alignment may add short-horizon lead context beyond rolling co-movement.

redundancy_policy.representative_rule: Within a highly redundant cluster retain the predeclared family representative unless another feature independently passes the inherited partial-Spearman screen against the same future-state target.
